about: The introitus of the formulary “Sexagesima Sunday” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Arise, why sleepest Thou, O Lord? Arise and cast us not off for ever. Why turnest Thou Thy face away and forgettest our tribulation? Our body cleaveth to the earth; arise, O Lord, help us and deliver us. O God, we have heard with our own ears; our fathers have declared unto us. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. Arise, why sleepest Thou, O Lord? Arise and cast us not off for ever. Why turnest Thou Thy face away and forgettest our tribulation? Our body cleaveth to the earth; arise, O Lord, help us and deliver us.
